propositions: Copilot, Codex, and Claude MCP clients must be configured to connect to the rebar MCP server via HTTP with static bearer token authentication
Each client requires a distinct config file shape and environment variable reference (MCP_CLIENT_PAT_COPILOT, MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CODEX, MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CLAUDE) for credential sourcing
Example client configs must be committed with environment variable placeholders, never inline PAT secrets
A hermetic test must verify that each client config loads correctly, resolves the bearer token from environment variables, and successfully calls a read tool against a loopback rebar-mcp instance
The test suite must confirm that requests lacking valid bearer tokens receive 401 responses and that no PAT literals appear in committed example configs
Per-client CLI acceptance checks must skip gracefully when the client binary is not installed, allowing CI to pass in hermetic environments
